1. (Currently amended) A packaging substrate comprising: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having at least one conductive path formed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the conductive path configured to provide electrical connection between an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, wherein the stiffening microstructure is formed from a material selected to increase lid or ring thickness and contact area to improve package coplanarity.

2. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to a bottom surface of the opening and extends into a core layer of the packaging structure.

3. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to a sidewall of the opening and is embedded within the packaging structure.

4. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface by a distance of at least 10 micrometers.

5. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer to expose an underlying core layer.

6. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 5, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a portion of the core layer, and the stiffening microstructure is in contact with the exposed core layer.

7. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising: an integrated circuit chip mounted on the chip mounting surface.

8. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 7, wherein the stiffening microstructure includes a lid.

9. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 8 further comprising: a heat transfer medium providing a thermally conductive pathway between the lid and the integrated circuit chip, wherein the heat transfer medium fills a gap between the lid and the integrated circuit chip.

10. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is a ring having an outer diameter greater than 500 micrometers.

11. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the ground reference plane layer is in direct contact with the stiffening microstructure through a conductive interface.

12. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a dielectric bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

13. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a conductive bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

14. (Currently amended) A computing device, comprising: a memory; and a packaged semiconductor device communicatively coupled to the memory, wherein the packaged semiconductor device comprises: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having at least one conductive path formed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure; an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and communicatively coupled to the memory through the packaging structure; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, wherein the stiffening microstructure is formed from a material selected to increase lid or ring thickness and contact area to improve package coplanarity.

15. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface and a sidewall of the opening and is embedded within the packaging structure.

16. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface by a distance of at least 10 micrometers.

17. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer to expose an underlying core layer.

18. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 17, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a portion of the core layer, and the stiffening microstructure is in contact with the exposed core layer.

19. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure is one of a ring or a lid, and the stiffening microstructure has a thickness greater than 50 micrometers.

20. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the stiffening microstructure is in contact with the ground reference plane layer through a conductive interface.
